description: A C# game engine in which a program opens a window, draws each frame with plain static calls named as raylib's functions are, and draws Dear ImGui in the same frame, over SDL3, Vulkan and Slang, with an ECS and source-generated behaviors underneath.
releaseNotes:
Fresnel's base is held to 0 to 1, so a point light at the camera's own point shades without black specks on lavapipe.
The gallery's pictures of the four edit mesh examples are made again from their new captures.
The screen's probes are looked up along the normal turned to the eye, so the back of a two-sided face takes the probes standing on it as its front does.
The prototype colors take Unreal's prototyping grays and orange and the grid steps at a level editor's quarter, half and whole meter with 1m lettered in each cell's corner, as BevyCSharp's.
A shadow's point is moved off its surface along the normal turned to the light's side, so a thin two-sided wall lit from its back no longer shadows itself in speckles.
The README opens with plain links to the devlog and the cheat sheet.
A verb of e3d followed by --help prints its own usage and does nothing else, so open with it starts no program.
title: 3DEngine
